messages:
Tess Moreno: heads-up: running a short PLG push next Tue — social launch posts + 30min 'how-to' webinar + 150 free tokens for first-run. goal: lift 24h activation by 5pt.

Ravi Kapoor: cohort? new signups last 60d who haven't run prompts?

Tess Moreno: yes, sample 3k users, 750 control. we'll tag experiment_id=plg_quickpush_2026.

Nia Brooks: creative: test messaging 'Starter prompts ready' vs '150 free tokens'. keep CTA 'Run your first prompt'. I'll prepare 3 post variants.

Ravi Kapoor: routing: prioritize users with last_login < 14d. if capacity issues, send email with starter template pack.

Tess Moreno: ops-bot please gate nudge behind flag plg_quickpush_nudge_v1 and schedule rollout 0->50%@6h->100%@24h with rollback on error >2%.

ops-bot: feature-flag created: plg_quickpush_nudge_v1. rollout policy set.
